newsitem.title: FRANCE: Emirates to start Paris-Taipei cargo link.
newsitem.headline: Emirates to start Paris-Taipei cargo link.

text.p: Dubai government-owned airline Emirates said it planned to offer off-line (indirect) full-freighter capacity from Paris to Taipei later this year.

"We are going to take a weekly block booking on a KLM Boeing 747 freighter service between Amsterdam and Taipei scheduled to be launched in spring 1997," a Paris-based Emirates cargo official told Reuters.
The official added: "We will have an allocation of one to two pallets on the flight and our objective is to generate around 20 tonnes of ex-Paris freight on the Taipei route each week."
Emirates will be trucking freight between Paris-CDG airport and Amsterdam Schiphol.

Emirates operates a three-times weekly Paris-Dubai and Nice-Rome-Dubai passenger services with Airbus A300s and A310s which can handle up to 12 tonnes of palletised cargo per flight. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
